name: Periglacial-Corrie
description: Rolling continents break around shallow seas, their interiors scored by an ancient meteor crater. Beyond tectonic rift valleys, the land runs to a horizon that feels hand-drawn.

There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure. Mats of pigment-bearing microbes stain the wet stone in bands of rust and violet.
Regular pulses leave the buried megastructure aimed at deep space, toward nothing catalogued. The pattern has repeated unchanged for the nine years anyone has listened.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
